Served items:
- Orange/apple juice, about 200 ml: 90 kcal
- Latte, about 250 ml with milk: 120 kcal
- Two peanut butter portions, about 15 g each: 180 kcal
- Two slices of multigrain bread, about 45 g each: 220 kcal
- Muffin, about 90 g: 320 kcal
- Two fried eggs: 180 kcal

Total served is about 1110 kcal.

Leftovers:
- Juice, about 120 ml: 55 kcal
- Bread, about 60% of one slice with peanut butter spread on it (some of the spread may be the second portion): 65 kcal for the bread plus about 60 kcal for the peanut butter
- Muffin, about 55% remaining: 175 kcal
- The coffee, eggs and the other slice of bread were finished.

Total left over is about 355 kcal, so about 755 kcal was eaten.

Macros eaten:
- Eggs: 12 g protein, 1 g carbs, 14 g fat
- Bread (about 1.4 slices): 6 g protein, 25 g carbs, 2 g fat
- Peanut butter (about 20 g): 5 g protein, 4 g carbs, 10 g fat
- Muffin (45%): 2.5 g protein, 22 g carbs, 7 g fat
- Latte: 6 g protein, 9 g carbs, 5 g fat
- Juice (80 ml): 9 g carbs

Totals are about 32 g protein, 70 g carbs and 38 g fat.
